title: "有" fiilinin "没" ile olumsuzu
summary: "有" (yǒu, sahip olmak/var olmak) fiili asla "不" ile değil, her zaman "没" ile olumsuzlanır: 没有 = yok / sahip değil.
explanation: Çince'de neredeyse tüm fiiller "不" ile olumsuzlanır, ama "有" bunun tek büyük istisnasıdır ve her zaman "没" alır. "没有" hem "sahip değilim" (mülkiyet) hem "yok" (varlık) hem de "-medi" (geçmiş eylem) anlamlarında kullanılır. Konuşma dilinde "有" düşüp sadece "没" da kalabilir. "不有" demek dilbilgisi hatasıdır.

title: "不" ile standart olumsuzlama
summary: "不" (bù) fiilin veya sıfatın önüne gelerek onu olumsuzlar; şimdiki, gelecek ve genel/alışkanlık durumları için kullanılır (geçmiş için "没" kullanılır).
explanation: "不", Çince'nin en temel olumsuzluk kelimesidir ve "有" dışındaki fiilleri, ayrıca sıfatları olumsuzlar. Ton kuralı önemlidir: "不" normalde 4. tondadır (bù), ama ardından başka bir 4. ton gelirse 2. tona döner (bú). Gerçekleşmemiş/geçmiş eylemleri anlatmak için "不" değil "没" kullanılır: "不去" = gitmiyorum/gitmeyeceğim, "没去" = gitmedim.

title: "都" ile "hepsi/tümü" belirteci
summary: "都" (dōu, hepsi/hep) çoğul özneden sonra, fiilden önce gelir ve "hepsi, tümü" anlamı katar.
explanation: "都", kastettiği ismin ARDINDAN, fiil veya sıfattan ÖNCE gelir — Türkçe'deki gibi öznenin başına değil. Yani "Hepimiz gidiyoruz" = 我们都去 (biz + hepsi + git). Olumsuzlukla birlikte konum anlamı değiştirir: "都不" = hiçbiri/hepsi değil, "不都" = hepsi değil (bazıları). "每" (her) ile birlikte neredeyse her zaman "都" kullanılır.

title: "也" ile "de/da" belirteci
summary: "也" (yě, de/da) özneden sonra, fiil veya sıfattan önce gelerek "o da, aynı şekilde" anlamı verir.
explanation: "也" her zaman fiilin/sıfatın hemen önünde durur ve cümlenin başına ya da sonuna konamaz — Türkçe'deki "da/de"nin aksine konumu sabittir. Başka belirteçlerle birlikte kullanılırken genellikle en başta gelir: "也都" (o da hepsi), "也不" (o da değil). "Ben de öyle" gibi kısa onaylar için "我也是" kalıbı kullanılır.

examples.zh: 他不仅聪明,人也很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cōngming, rén yě hěn hǎo.

examples.zh: 就是走一天,我也要走到那座山上。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì zǒu yì tiān, wǒ yě yào zǒudào nà zuò shān shàng.
examples.en: Even if it takes a whole day of walking, I want to reach that mountain.

examples.zh: 你去哪儿我也去哪儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ yě qù nǎr.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll go too.

title: "和" ile "ve" bağlacı
summary: "和" (hé, ve) iki ismi (veya isim öbeğini) birbirine bağlar. Yalnızca isimler için kullanılır — cümleleri bağlamak için kullanılmaz.
explanation: "和" Türkçe'deki "ve" gibi görünse de önemli bir fark vardır: yalnızca isimleri/isim öbeklerini bağlar, İngilizce'deki gibi iki tam cümleyi veya fiili bağlamaz. "Ben yemek yerim VE film izlerim" derken "和" kullanılmaz; onun yerine cümleler yan yana dizilir veya başka bağlaçlar kullanılır. İkiden fazla ismi listelerken "和" genellikle sadece son iki öge arasına konur.

examples.zh: 我和他都不去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā dōu bú qù.
examples.en: Neither he nor I are going.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一本书和一支笔。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū hé yì zhī bǐ.
examples.en: There's a book and a pen on the table.

examples.zh: 我喜欢中国菜和日本菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngguó cài hé Rìběn cài.
examples.en: I like Chinese food and Japanese food.

examples.zh: 爸爸和妈妈都在厨房里忙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba hé māma dōu zài chúfáng lǐ máng.
examples.en: Both dad and mom are busy in the kitchen.

examples.zh: 这个周末我和朋友们要去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ hé péngyoumen yào qù páshān.
examples.en: This weekend my friends and I are going hiking.

examples.zh: 老师和学生们一起打扫了教室。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hé xuéshengmen yìqǐ dǎsǎo le jiàoshì.
examples.en: The teacher and the students cleaned the classroom together.

examples.zh: 我的哥哥和姐姐都已经结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge hé jiějie dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le.
examples.en: My older brother and older sister are both married.

examples.zh: 健康和快乐比钱更重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng hé kuàilè bǐ qián gèng zhòngyào.
examples.en: Health and happiness are more important than money.

examples.zh: 请把你的名字和电话号码写在这里。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de míngzi hé diànhuà hàomǎ xiě zài zhèlǐ.

examples.zh: 这本书讲的是历史和文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng de shì lìshǐ hé wénhuà.
examples.en: This book is about history and culture.

examples.zh: 我和我的同事关系很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ de tóngshì guānxi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I have a good relationship with my colleagues.

examples.zh: 她买了苹果、香蕉和橘子。
examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo hé júzi.
examples.en: She bought apples, bananas, and oranges.

examples.zh: 春天和秋天是这里最美的季节。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān hé qiūtiān shì zhèlǐ zuì měi de jìjié.
examples.en: Spring and autumn are the most beautiful seasons here.

examples.zh: 这件事和我一点儿关系也没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hé wǒ yìdiǎnr guānxi yě méiyǒu.
examples.en: This matter has nothing to do with me at all.

examples.zh: 你和他的想法完全不一样。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hé tā de xiǎngfǎ wánquán bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Your idea and his are completely different.

examples.zh: 我需要一些时间和空间好好想一想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yìxiē shíjiān hé kōngjiān hǎohǎo xiǎng yi xiǎng.
examples.en: I need some time and space to think it over.

examples.zh: 老人和孩子在公园里晒太阳。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén hé háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ shài tàiyáng.
examples.en: The elderly and children are sunbathing in the park.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我认识了很多新朋友和新地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ rènshi le hěn duō xīn péngyou hé xīn dìfang.
examples.en: This trip introduced me to many new friends and new places.

examples.zh: 成功需要努力和一点点运气。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng xūyào nǔlì hé yìdiǎndiǎn yùnqì.
examples.en: Success needs hard work and a little bit of luck.

examples.zh: 他和我是从小一起长大的。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé wǒ shì cóngxiǎo yìqǐ zhǎngdà de.
examples.en: He and I grew up together from childhood.

examples.zh: 我把水果和蔬菜放进了冰箱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shuǐguǒ hé shūcài fàng jìn le bīngxiāng.
examples.en: I put the fruits and vegetables into the fridge.

examples.zh: 这个城市的白天和晚上完全是两个样子。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de báitiān hé wǎnshang wánquán shì liǎng ge yàngzi.
examples.en: This city looks completely different during the day and at night.

examples.zh: 我和她聊了很久关于未来的事。

examples.zh: 父母的爱和支持给了我很大的力量。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de ài hé zhīchí gěi le wǒ hěn dà de lìliàng.

examples.zh: 茶和咖啡,你更喜欢哪一个？
examples.pinyin: Chá hé kāfēi, nǐ gèng xǐhuan nǎ yí ge?
examples.en: Tea and coffee, which one do you prefer?

title: "还是" ile seçenek sunma
summary: "还是" (háishì), bir soruda iki seçenek sunmak için A ile B'nin arasına konur: "A mı yoksa B mi?"
explanation: "还是", cevabı iki (veya daha fazla) belirli seçenek arasından isteyen seçmeli sorularda kullanılır. Bu tür sorularda cümlenin sonuna "吗" EKLENMEZ, çünkü "还是" zaten soruyu oluşturur. Dikkat: "或者" (huòzhě) da "veya" demektir ama o soru DEĞİL düz cümlelerde kullanılır. Yani soru sorarken "还是", cevap/ifade verirken "或者".

examples.zh: 你要喝茶还是咖啡？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē chá háishì kāfēi?
examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 我们今天去还是明天去？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān qù háishì míngtiān qù?
examples.en: Are we going today or tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这个是你的还是他的？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shì nǐ de háishì tā de?
examples.en: Is this yours or his?

examples.zh: 你想吃米饭还是面条？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī mǐfàn háishì miàntiáo?
examples.en: Do you want to eat rice or noodles?

examples.zh: 我们坐地铁还是坐出租车比较快？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò dìtiě háishì zuò chūzūchē bǐjiào kuài?
examples.en: Is it faster to take the subway or a taxi?

examples.zh: 你是学生还是老师？

examples.en: Should I tell him about this or not?

examples.zh: 你喜欢住在城市还是住在乡下？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan zhù zài chéngshì háishì zhù zài xiāngxià?
examples.en: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?

examples.zh: 你想现在走还是等雨停了再走？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xiànzài zǒu háishì děng yǔ tíng le zài zǒu?
examples.en: Do you want to leave now or wait until the rain stops?

examples.zh: 你觉得红色的好看还是蓝色的好看？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde hóngsè de hǎokàn háishì lánsè de hǎokàn?
examples.en: Do you think the red one looks better or the blue one?

examples.zh: 这次的问题是他的错还是你的错？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de wèntí shì tā de cuò háishì nǐ de cuò?

examples.zh: 你打算坐飞机还是坐火车去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī háishì zuò huǒchē qù?
examples.en: Are you planning to go by plane or by train?

examples.zh: 我们是先吃饭还是先看电影？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì xiān chīfàn háishì xiān kàn diànyǐng?
examples.en: Should we eat first or watch the movie first?

examples.zh: 你是一个人来的还是和朋友一起来的？

examples.zh: 我们在这里等他还是先进去？

examples.en: Should we wait for him here or go in first?

examples.zh: 你更相信他说的还是她说的？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gèng xiāngxìn tā shuō de háishì tā shuō de?
examples.en: Do you believe more what he said or what she said?

examples.zh: 周末你想休息还是想出去玩？
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò nǐ xiǎng xiūxi háishì xiǎng chūqù wán?
examples.en: On the weekend, do you want to rest or go out and have fun?

examples.zh: 这份工作你打算接受还是拒绝？

examples.en: Are you going to accept this job or turn it down?

examples.en: Is this character read in the first tone or the fourth tone?

examples.zh: 你们是打算住酒店还是住朋友家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen shì dǎsuàn zhù jiǔdiàn háishì zhù péngyou jiā?
examples.en: Are you planning to stay at a hotel or a friend's place?

examples.zh: 是我去找你还是你来找我？
examples.pinyin: Shì wǒ qù zhǎo nǐ háishì nǐ lái zhǎo wǒ?
examples.en: Should I go find you or will you come find me?

examples.zh: 你到底是同意还是不同意？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ shì tóngyì háishì bù tóngyì?
examples.en: Do you agree or not, after all?

title: "岁" ile yaş söyleme
summary: Yaş, "Özne + sayı + 岁 (suì)" kalıbıyla söylenir; bu cümlede "是" fiiline gerek yoktur.
explanation: Çince'de yaş bildirirken sayıdan sonra "岁" (suì, yaş) ölçü sözcüğü kullanılır ve genellikle "是" fiili KULLANILMAZ: "我二十岁" (ben yirmi yaşındayım). Yaş sormak için "多大" (büyükler için) veya "几岁" (küçük çocuklar için) kullanılır. "是" yalnızca vurgu için eklenebilir: "我是二十岁".

examples.en: I am twenty years old this year.

examples.zh: 你女儿几岁了？

examples.zh: 我弟弟比我小三岁。

examples.en: My younger brother is three years younger than me.

examples.zh: 这个孩子才五岁,已经会写字了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi cái wǔ suì, yǐjīng huì xiězì le.
examples.en: This child is only five years old and can already write.

examples.pinyin: Tā nǎinai jīnnián bāshí suì le, shēntǐ hái hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Her grandma is eighty this year and still in good health.

examples.zh: 请问您多大岁数了？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nín duō dà suìshu le?
examples.en: May I ask how old you are?

examples.zh: 我三十岁才开始学中文。

examples.zh: 两个孩子,一个七岁,一个九岁。

examples.zh: 她看起来不像四十岁的人。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye jiǔshí suì de shíhou hái měitiān sànbù.

examples.zh: 孩子六岁以后就应该上学了。

examples.zh: 我二十五岁那年找到了第一份工作。

examples.en: I found my first job the year I was twenty-five.

examples.en: I started learning to swim when I was twelve.

examples.zh: 他四十多岁了,还像年轻人一样有活力。
examples.pinyin: Tā sìshí duō suì le, hái xiàng niánqīngrén yíyàng yǒu huólì.

examples.zh: 这个小女孩三岁就会背很多首诗。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō shǒu shī.
examples.en: This little girl could recite many poems at just three.

examples.zh: 到了一定的岁数,人就会开始怀念过去。
examples.pinyin: Dào le yídìng de suìshu, rén jiù huì kāishǐ huáiniàn guòqù.
examples.en: At a certain age, people start to miss the past.

examples.zh: 我今年已经不小了,不能再像小孩子一样。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián yǐjīng bù xiǎo le, bù néng zài xiàng xiǎoháizi yíyàng.
examples.en: I'm not young anymore and can't act like a child.

examples.zh: 她比我大两岁,但是我们像同龄人一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì, dànshì wǒmen xiàng tónglíngrén yíyàng.
examples.en: She's two years older than me, but we're like peers.

title: "个" ölçü sözcüğü
summary: Çince'de sayı ile isim arasına bir ölçü sözcüğü girer; "个" (ge) en yaygın ve genel amaçlı olanıdır.
explanation: Çince'de bir ismi sayarken doğrudan "sayı + isim" denmez; araya bir ölçü sözcüğü (量词) girer. "个" en genel ölçü sözcüğüdür ve doğru ölçü sözcüğünü bilmediğinizde çoğu insanla ilgili ve genel nesne için kullanılabilir. "个" genellikle hafif tonda (ge) okunur. "这/那" (bu/şu) ve "几" (kaç) de sayı gibi davranır: 这个人 (bu kişi), 几个 (kaç tane).

examples.zh: 我有一个问题想问你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ.
examples.en: I have a question I want to ask you.

examples.zh: 我们班有三十个学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu sānshí ge xuésheng.
examples.en: Our class has thirty students.

examples.zh: 这个人我好像在哪里见过。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎlǐ jiànguò.
examples.en: I feel like I've seen this person somewhere.

examples.zh: 给我两个苹果和一个橘子。
examples.pinyin: Gěi wǒ liǎng ge píngguǒ hé yí ge júzi.
examples.en: Give me two apples and one orange.

examples.zh: 他一个人住在这么大的房子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zhù zài zhème dà de fángzi lǐ.
examples.en: He lives alone in such a big house.

examples.zh: 这个月我花了很多钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: I spent a lot of money this month.

examples.zh: 我想请你帮我一个忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng.
examples.en: I'd like to ask you for a favor.

examples.zh: 那个穿红衣服的女孩是谁？
examples.pinyin: Nàge chuān hóng yīfu de nǚhái shì shéi?
examples.en: Who is that girl in the red clothes?

examples.zh: 我们花了三个小时才到山顶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huā le sān ge xiǎoshí cái dào shāndǐng.
examples.en: It took us three hours to reach the mountaintop.

examples.zh: 这几个孩子都很有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge háizi dōu hěn yǒu lǐmào.
examples.en: These few children are all very polite.

examples.zh: 他每个星期都会给妈妈打一个电话。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqī dōu huì gěi māma dǎ yí ge diànhuà.
examples.en: He calls his mom once every week.

examples.zh: 这个决定改变了我的一生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng gǎibiàn le wǒ de yìshēng.
examples.en: This decision changed my whole life.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着几个空杯子。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe jǐ ge kōng bēizi.
examples.en: There are a few empty cups on the table.

examples.zh: 我认识一个会说五种语言的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi yí ge huì shuō wǔ zhǒng yǔyán de rén.
examples.en: I know a person who can speak five languages.

examples.zh: 这个星期天我们打算去看一个朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān wǒmen dǎsuàn qù kàn yí ge péngyou.
examples.en: This Sunday we plan to visit a friend.

examples.zh: 他一口气吃了三个包子。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì chī le sān ge bāozi.
examples.en: He ate three buns in one go.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: Everyone has their own dream.

examples.zh: 我在这个城市住了十个年头了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège chéngshì zhù le shí ge niántóu le.
examples.en: I've lived in this city for ten years now.

examples.zh: 这个办法听起来是个好主意。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ tīng qǐlái shì ge hǎo zhǔyi.
examples.en: This method sounds like a good idea.

examples.zh: 他给我讲了一个很有意思的故事。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiǎng le yí ge hěn yǒu yìsi de gùshi.
examples.en: He told me a very interesting story.

examples.zh: 我们需要再找几个人来帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài zhǎo jǐ ge rén lái bāngmáng.
examples.en: We need to find a few more people to help.

examples.zh: 这个季节的水果又新鲜又便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìjié de shuǐguǒ yòu xīnxiān yòu piányi.
examples.en: The fruit this season is both fresh and cheap.

examples.zh: 他是一个值得信任的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge zhídé xìnrèn de rén.
examples.en: He is a person worth trusting.

examples.zh: 我想在市中心买一个小房子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài shìzhōngxīn mǎi yí ge xiǎo fángzi.
examples.en: I want to buy a small house in the city center.

examples.zh: 这个世界上没有一个人是完美的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìjiè shàng méiyǒu yí ge rén shì wánměi de.
examples.en: There is no perfect person in this world.

title: Tarihlerin yapısı
pattern: Sayı + 年 + Sayı + 月 + Sayı + 号
summary: Çince'de tarih büyükten küçüğe yazılır: önce yıl (年), sonra ay (月), sonra gün (号/日).
explanation: Çince tarih sıralaması Türkçe'nin tersidir: en büyük birimden en küçüğe gider — yıl → ay → gün. Yıl için "年" (nián), ay için "月" (yuè), gün için konuşma dilinde "号" (hào) veya resmî yazıda "日" (rì) kullanılır. Aylar sadece sayı + 月'dir: 一月 (Ocak), 十二月 (Aralık). Bu cümlelerde de "是" çoğu zaman kullanılmaz.

examples.zh: 今天是三月八号。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì sān yuè bā hào.
examples.en: Today is March 8th.

examples.zh: 我的生日是十月一号。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shēngri shì shí yuè yī hào.
examples.en: My birthday is October 1st.

examples.zh: 他们打算在明年五月结婚。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn zài míngnián wǔ yuè jiéhūn.
examples.en: They plan to get married next May.

examples.zh: 这家公司是二零一零年成立的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì èr líng yī líng nián chénglì de.
examples.en: This company was founded in 2010.

examples.zh: 考试是下个月十五号。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shì xià ge yuè shíwǔ hào.
examples.en: The exam is on the 15th of next month.

examples.zh: 我是一九九五年出生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián chūshēng de.
examples.en: I was born in 1995.

examples.zh: 从七月一号开始放暑假。
examples.pinyin: Cóng qī yuè yī hào kāishǐ fàng shǔjià.
examples.en: Summer vacation starts on July 1st.

examples.zh: 每年十二月都很冷。
examples.pinyin: Měinián shí'èr yuè dōu hěn lěng.
examples.en: December is cold every year.

examples.zh: 她的婚礼定在六月十号。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hūnlǐ dìng zài liù yuè shí hào.
examples.en: Her wedding is set for June 10th.

examples.zh: 这件事发生在去年八月。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng zài qùnián bā yuè.
examples.en: This happened last August.

examples.zh: 我们的会议改到了三月二十号。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de huìyì gǎidào le sān yuè èrshí hào.
examples.en: Our meeting was moved to March 20th.

examples.zh: 中国的春节一般在一月或二月。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de Chūnjié yìbān zài yī yuè huò èr yuè.
examples.en: Chinese New Year is usually in January or February.

examples.zh: 请在四月底以前交作业。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài sì yuè dǐ yǐqián jiāo zuòyè.
examples.en: Please hand in the homework before the end of April.

examples.zh: 他是二零零八年来到北京的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì èr líng líng bā nián láidào Běijīng de.
examples.en: He came to Beijing in 2008.

examples.zh: 我记得那天是九月三号,天气很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde nà tiān shì jiǔ yuè sān hào, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I remember that day was September 3rd, and the weather was nice.

examples.zh: 新学期从九月一号开始。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī cóng jiǔ yuè yī hào kāishǐ.
examples.en: The new semester starts on September 1st.

examples.zh: 这本书是二零二零年出版的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng èr líng nián chūbǎn de.
examples.en: This book was published in 2020.

examples.zh: 你的护照到明年三月就过期了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de hùzhào dào míngnián sān yuè jiù guòqī le.
examples.en: Your passport expires next March.

examples.zh: 十一月的天气不冷也不热。
examples.pinyin: Shíyī yuè de tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.en: November weather is neither cold nor hot.

examples.zh: 我们是二零一五年五月认识的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì èr líng yī wǔ nián wǔ yuè rènshi de.
examples.en: We met in May 2015.

examples.zh: 下个星期五是四月一号。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīwǔ shì sì yuè yī hào.
examples.en: Next Friday is April 1st.

examples.zh: 这个节日每年十月都会举行。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiérì měinián shí yuè dōu huì jǔxíng.
examples.en: This festival is held every October.

examples.zh: 我打算七月中旬去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn qī yuè zhōngxún qù lǚxíng.
examples.en: I plan to travel in mid-July.

examples.zh: 他的合同到十二月三十一号结束。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hétong dào shí'èr yuè sānshíyī hào jiéshù.
examples.en: His contract ends on December 31st.

examples.zh: 我永远记得二零一二年那个夏天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn jìde èr líng yī èr nián nàge xiàtiān.
examples.en: I'll always remember that summer of 2012.

title: Haftanın günlerinin yapısı
titleEn: Structure of days of the week
summary: Haftanın günleri "星期" (xīngqī) + sayı ile yapılır: 星期一 (Pazartesi) ... 星期六 (Cumartesi). Pazar istisnadır: 星期天/星期日.
explanation: Haftanın günleri çok düzenlidir: "星期" (hafta) + gün sayısı. 星期一 = 1. gün = Pazartesi, 星期二 = Salı, ... 星期六 = Cumartesi. Pazar için sayı değil "天" veya "日" kullanılır: 星期天 (konuşma) / 星期日 (resmî). "礼拜" (lǐbài) de aynı anlamda kullanılabilir. Bu cümlelerde de "是" çoğunlukla düşer: 今天星期三.

examples.zh: 今天星期三,后天星期五。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xīngqīsān, hòutiān xīngqīwǔ.
examples.en: Today is Wednesday, the day after tomorrow is Friday.

examples.zh: 我们每个星期一开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měi ge xīngqīyī kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting every Monday.

examples.zh: 星期六我不用上班。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīliù wǒ búyòng shàngbān.
examples.en: I don't have to work on Saturday.

examples.zh: 这家博物馆星期一不开门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn xīngqīyī bù kāimén.
examples.en: This museum is closed on Mondays.

examples.zh: 你星期几有空？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqī jǐ yǒu kòng?
examples.en: Which day of the week are you free?

examples.zh: 我们打算星期天去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn xīngqītiān qù páshān.
examples.en: We plan to go hiking on Sunday.

examples.zh: 从星期一到星期五我都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ wǒ dōu hěn máng.
examples.en: I'm busy from Monday to Friday.

examples.zh: 他每个星期二晚上去学画画。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqī'èr wǎnshang qù xué huàhuà.
examples.en: He goes to painting class every Tuesday evening.

examples.zh: 这个星期四是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīsì shì wǒ de shēngri.
examples.en: This Thursday is my birthday.

examples.zh: 星期五下班以后我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīwǔ xiàbān yǐhòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn ba.
examples.en: Let's have dinner together after work on Friday.

examples.zh: 我上个星期天睡了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqītiān shuì le yìzhěng tiān.
examples.en: I slept the whole day last Sunday.

examples.zh: 下个星期一我要去出差。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīyī wǒ yào qù chūchāi.
examples.en: I'm going on a business trip next Monday.

examples.zh: 孩子们最喜欢星期六和星期天。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zuì xǐhuan xīngqīliù hé xīngqītiān.
examples.en: Children like Saturdays and Sundays the most.

examples.zh: 这个星期三我们没有课。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīsān wǒmen méiyǒu kè.
examples.en: We don't have class this Wednesday.

examples.zh: 她答应我下个星期四给我回信。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying wǒ xià ge xīngqīsì gěi wǒ huíxìn.
examples.en: She promised to reply to me next Thursday.

examples.zh: 星期天的早上,街上人很少。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqītiān de zǎoshang, jiē shàng rén hěn shǎo.
examples.en: On Sunday mornings, there are few people on the streets.

examples.zh: 我们的中文课是每个星期二和星期四。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè shì měi ge xīngqī'èr hé xīngqīsì.
examples.en: Our Chinese class is every Tuesday and Thursday.

examples.zh: 星期一总是让人觉得很累。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīyī zǒngshì ràng rén juéde hěn lèi.
examples.en: Mondays always make people feel tired.

examples.zh: 这个星期六有一场重要的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīliù yǒu yì chǎng zhòngyào de bǐsài.
examples.en: There's an important match this Saturday.

examples.zh: 我忘了今天是星期几了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le jīntiān shì xīngqī jǐ le.
examples.en: I forgot what day of the week it is today.

examples.zh: 每个星期天我都会给父母打电话。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge xīngqītiān wǒ dōu huì gěi fùmǔ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I call my parents every Sunday.

examples.zh: 我们的假期从这个星期五开始。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàqī cóng zhège xīngqīwǔ kāishǐ.
examples.en: Our vacation starts this Friday.

examples.zh: 他星期三就要回国了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīngqīsān jiù yào huíguó le.
examples.en: He's going back to his country this Wednesday.

examples.zh: 下个星期六我要参加一个婚礼。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīliù wǒ yào cānjiā yí ge hūnlǐ.
examples.en: Next Saturday I'm attending a wedding.

examples.zh: 一个星期有七天,可是感觉过得很快。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqī yǒu qī tiān, kěshì gǎnjué guò de hěn kuài.
examples.en: A week has seven days, but it feels like it passes quickly.

title: Sayıların yapısı
pattern: Sayı + Birim (十 / 百 / 千 / 万)
summary: Çince sayılar 十 (on), 百 (yüz), 千 (bin), 万 (on bin) birimleriyle düzenli biçimde kurulur.
explanation: Çince sayı sistemi çok düzenlidir: 11 = 十一 (on-bir), 20 = 二十 (iki-on), 35 = 三十五 (üç-on-beş). Yüzler 百, binler 千, ve önemli fark: Çince'de 万 (on bin) ayrı bir birimdir. Yani 10.000 = 一万, 100.000 = 十万. "二" (èr) ve "两" (liǎng) her ikisi de "iki" demektir ama farklı yerlerde kullanılır (ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 三百五十九是一个奇数。
examples.pinyin: Sānbǎi wǔshíjiǔ shì yí ge jīshù.
examples.en: 359 is an odd number.

examples.zh: 这本书一共有五百多页。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng yǒu wǔbǎi duō yè.
examples.en: This book has over five hundred pages in total.

examples.zh: 这台电脑要八千块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo yào bāqiān kuài qián.
examples.en: This computer costs eight thousand yuan.

examples.zh: 我们公司有一千多个员工。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī yǒu yìqiān duō ge yuángōng.
examples.en: Our company has over a thousand employees.

examples.zh: 这座城市有五百万人口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu wǔbǎiwàn rénkǒu.
examples.en: This city has a population of five million.

examples.zh: 从一数到一百对孩子来说不难。
examples.pinyin: Cóng yī shǔ dào yìbǎi duì háizi lái shuō bù nán.
examples.en: Counting from one to a hundred isn't hard for a child.

examples.zh: 这次活动来了三千多个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng lái le sānqiān duō ge rén.
examples.en: Over three thousand people came to this event.

examples.zh: 他一个月挣一万块钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge yuè zhèng yíwàn kuài qián.
examples.en: He earns ten thousand yuan a month.

examples.zh: 这条河有两千多公里长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǒu liǎngqiān duō gōnglǐ cháng.
examples.en: This river is over two thousand kilometers long.

examples.zh: 一年有三百六十五天。
examples.pinyin: Yì nián yǒu sānbǎi liùshíwǔ tiān.
examples.en: A year has three hundred sixty-five days.

examples.zh: 这幅画卖了十万块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà mài le shíwàn kuài qián.
examples.en: This painting sold for a hundred thousand yuan.

examples.zh: 他家离公司大概有二十公里。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí gōngsī dàgài yǒu èrshí gōnglǐ.
examples.en: His home is about twenty kilometers from the company.

examples.zh: 这个数字太大了,我念不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shùzì tài dà le, wǒ niàn bu chūlái.
examples.en: This number is too big, I can't read it out.

examples.zh: 我们班一共有四十五个学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yígòng yǒu sìshíwǔ ge xuésheng.
examples.en: Our class has forty-five students in total.

examples.zh: 这件事发生在一百多年以前。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng zài yìbǎi duō nián yǐqián.
examples.en: This happened over a hundred years ago.

examples.zh: 我数了三遍,一共是九十九个。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shǔ le sān biàn, yígòng shì jiǔshíjiǔ ge.
examples.en: I counted three times, it's ninety-nine in total.

examples.zh: 这次考试满分是一百分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì mǎnfēn shì yìbǎi fēn.
examples.en: The full score of this exam is one hundred.

examples.zh: 他借了我五千块钱,还没还。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè le wǒ wǔqiān kuài qián, hái méi huán.
examples.en: He borrowed five thousand yuan from me and hasn't paid it back.

examples.zh: 这个村子只有三百多口人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi zhǐ yǒu sānbǎi duō kǒu rén.
examples.en: This village has only a little over three hundred people.

examples.zh: 一万块钱在大城市不够花一个月。
examples.pinyin: Yíwàn kuài qián zài dà chéngshì búgòu huā yí ge yuè.
examples.en: Ten thousand yuan isn't enough for a month in a big city.

examples.zh: 这场音乐会有两千个座位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yīnyuèhuì yǒu liǎngqiān ge zuòwèi.
examples.en: This concert has two thousand seats.

examples.zh: 他跑了五千米还不觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo le wǔqiān mǐ hái bù juéde lèi.
examples.en: He ran five thousand meters and still didn't feel tired.

examples.zh: 这本词典有六万多个词。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn yǒu liùwàn duō ge cí.
examples.en: This dictionary has over sixty thousand words.

examples.zh: 从一百减到零需要一点时间。
examples.pinyin: Cóng yìbǎi jiǎn dào líng xūyào yìdiǎn shíjiān.
examples.en: Counting down from a hundred to zero takes a little time.

examples.zh: 这个数加上那个数正好是一千。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shù jiā shàng nàge shù zhènghǎo shì yìqiān.
examples.en: This number plus that number is exactly one thousand.

title: Saatlerin yapısı (temel)
summary: Saat, sayı + "点" (diǎn) ile söylenir: 三点 = saat üç. İsteğe bağlı olarak "钟" eklenebilir.
explanation: Çince'de saat söylerken "点" (diǎn, nokta/saat) kullanılır: 一点 (saat bir), 十点 (saat on). İsteğe bağlı "钟" (zhōng) eklenebilir: 三点钟. Dakika için "分" (fēn) kullanılır (ileri konu). Önemli: "iki" saat söylerken "两点" (liǎng diǎn) denir, "二点" değil. "半" (bàn, yarım) buçuğu belirtir: 三点半 (üç buçuk).

examples.zh: 现在十一点,我们该睡觉了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shíyī diǎn, wǒmen gāi shuìjiào le.
examples.en: It's eleven o'clock now, we should go to bed.

examples.zh: 我每天早上六点起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: I get up at six every morning.

examples.zh: 火车八点准时开。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē bā diǎn zhǔnshí kāi.
examples.en: The train departs at eight sharp.

examples.zh: 我们两点在门口见面吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎng diǎn zài ménkǒu jiànmiàn ba.
examples.en: Let's meet at the door at two o'clock.

examples.zh: 他一般晚上十点以后才回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbān wǎnshang shí diǎn yǐhòu cái huíjiā.
examples.en: He usually gets home only after ten at night.

examples.zh: 现在几点了？我的表停了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn le? Wǒ de biǎo tíng le.
examples.en: What time is it now? My watch has stopped.

examples.zh: 商店早上九点开门。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn kāimén.
examples.en: The shop opens at nine in the morning.

examples.zh: 我们下午三点开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting at three in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 电影七点开始,我们六点半出发吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng qī diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen liù diǎn bàn chūfā ba.

title: "的" olmadan yakınlık iyeliği

title: "的" ile iyelik
summary: "的" (de) iki isim arasına girerek iyelik/aitlik kurar: 我的书 = benim kitabım, 老师的车 = öğretmenin arabası.
explanation: "的", Türkçe'deki "-in/-nin" iyelik ekine karşılık gelir ve sahibi ile sahip olunan şeyin arasına konur: A + 的 + B = A'nın B'si. Bağlam açıksa ikinci isim düşebilir: 这是我的 (bu benim). Ayrıca sıfat/öbek + 的 + isim kalıbıyla isimleri niteler (ayrı konu). Yakın ilişkilerde "的" atılabilir (bkz. önceki konu).

title: "吧" ile öneri yapma

examples.zh: 我们先吃饭,吃完再工作吧。

examples.zh: 这个问题太难了,还是问问老师吧。

examples.zh: 你一定很饿了吧,快去吃点东西。

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, wǒmen chūqù zǒuzou ba.

examples.zh: 这件衣服挺适合你的,买了吧。

examples.zh: 好吧,这次听你的。

examples.en: You don't look well today, are you sick?

examples.zh: 这些旧衣服就送给需要的人吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù yīfu jiù sòng gěi xūyào de rén ba.
examples.en: Let's give these old clothes to people who need them.

examples.zh: 事情已经这样了,我们往前看吧。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing yǐjīng zhèyàng le, wǒmen wǎng qián kàn ba.
examples.en: Things are already like this, let's look forward.

examples.zh: 你说得对,就按你说的做吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, jiù àn nǐ shuō de zuò ba.
examples.en: You're right, let's do it your way.

title: "在" ile bir yerde bulunma
titleEn: Expressing existence in a place with "zai"
summary: "在" (zài) fiili bir kişi/nesnenin bir yerde bulunduğunu belirtir: 老师在上海 = Öğretmen Şanghay'da.
explanation: "在" bir varlığın nerede olduğunu söyleyen fiildir: Özne + 在 + yer = Özne, ...dadır. Olumsuzu "不在": 他不在家 (o evde değil). Dikkat: "在" ayrıca bir eylemin nerede yapıldığını belirtmek için fiilden önce edat olarak da kullanılır (我在家吃饭 - evde yemek yerim) ve süregelen eylemi göstermek için de kullanılır (ayrı konular). Yer sözcükleri genellikle "上/里/旁边" gibi konum sözcükleriyle netleşir.

examples.zh: 老师现在在办公室。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiànzài zài bàngōngshì.
examples.en: The teacher is in the office now.

examples.zh: 你的手机在桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: Your phone is on the table.

examples.zh: 对不起,王经理现在不在。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, Wáng jīnglǐ xiànzài bú zài.
examples.en: Sorry, Manager Wang is not in right now.

examples.zh: 孩子们都在楼下的花园里玩。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen dōu zài lóuxià de huāyuán lǐ wán.
examples.en: The children are all playing in the garden downstairs.

examples.zh: 我的钥匙好像在包里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi hǎoxiàng zài bāo lǐ.
examples.en: My keys seem to be in the bag.

examples.zh: 他家在这座山的后面。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā zài zhè zuò shān de hòumiàn.
examples.en: His home is behind this mountain.

examples.zh: 你要找的那本书在书架的最上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǎo de nà běn shū zài shūjià de zuì shàngmiàn.
examples.en: The book you're looking for is at the top of the shelf.

examples.zh: 请问,洗手间在哪里？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
examples.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.zh: 我父母现在在国外旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ xiànzài zài guówài lǚxíng.
examples.en: My parents are traveling abroad right now.

examples.zh: 猫又不在它自己的窝里了。
examples.pinyin: Māo yòu bú zài tā zìjǐ de wō lǐ le.
examples.en: The cat is again not in its own bed.

examples.zh: 你的座位在前面还是后面？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zuòwèi zài qiánmiàn háishì hòumiàn?
examples.en: Is your seat at the front or the back?

examples.zh: 重要的文件都在这个抽屉里。
examples.pinyin: Zhòngyào de wénjiàn dōu zài zhège chōuti lǐ.
examples.en: The important documents are all in this drawer.

examples.zh: 他不在办公室,可能去开会了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú zài bàngōngshì, kěnéng qù kāihuì le.
examples.en: He's not in the office, he might have gone to a meeting.

examples.zh: 我们约好在电影院门口见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu jiàn.
examples.en: We agreed to meet at the cinema entrance.

examples.zh: 答案其实一直都在你心里。
examples.pinyin: Dá'àn qíshí yìzhí dōu zài nǐ xīnlǐ.
examples.en: The answer has always been in your heart.

examples.zh: 你要的资料在电脑里,我发给你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào de zīliào zài diànnǎo lǐ, wǒ fā gěi nǐ.
examples.en: The materials you want are on the computer, I'll send them to you.

examples.zh: 车站就在那家银行的对面。
examples.pinyin: Chēzhàn jiù zài nà jiā yínháng de duìmiàn.
examples.en: The station is right across from that bank.

examples.zh: 这个时候他一般都在健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíhou tā yìbān dōu zài jiànshēnfáng.
examples.en: At this time he's usually at the gym.

examples.zh: 我的心一直在你身边。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn yìzhí zài nǐ shēnbiān.
examples.en: My heart has always been by your side.

examples.zh: 钱包不在口袋里,也不在包里。
examples.pinyin: Qiánbāo bú zài kǒudài lǐ, yě bú zài bāo lǐ.
examples.en: The wallet isn't in the pocket, nor in the bag.

examples.zh: 你找的人不在这里,他已经搬走了。

examples.en: He spent the whole day reading in the library.

examples.zh: 问题的关键在于我们怎么解决它。
examples.pinyin: Wèntí de guānjiàn zàiyú wǒmen zěnme jiějué tā.
examples.en: The key to the problem lies in how we solve it.

title: "有" ile bir yerde bir şeyin var olması
summary: "Yer + 有 + nesne" kalıbı bir yerde bir şeyin bulunduğunu/var olduğunu anlatır: 桌子上有一本书 = Masanın üstünde bir kitap var.
explanation: "有" mülkiyetin yanı sıra "var olma / bulunma" anlamında da kullanılır. Kalıp: yer + 有 + nesne. Bu, "在"'ın tersidir: "在" belirli bir şeyin nerede olduğunu söyler (bilinenden yere), "有" ise bir yerde ne olduğunu söyler (yerden bilinmeyene). Olumsuzu her zaman "没有": 桌子上没有书 (masada kitap yok). Genellikle belirsiz/yeni bir nesneyi tanıtır.

examples.zh: 这座山上有一座很古老的寺庙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān shàng yǒu yí zuò hěn gǔlǎo de sìmiào.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bèihòu yǒu yí ge gǎnrén de gùshi.

examples.zh: 生活里总是有一些让人开心的小事。

title: "有" ile mülkiyet belirtme
summary: "有" (yǒu) bir kişinin bir şeye sahip olduğunu belirtir: 我有一辆车 = Benim bir arabam var.
explanation: "有" hem "sahip olmak" hem "var olmak" fiilidir. Mülkiyet anlamında kalıp: Özne + 有 + nesne. Türkçe'deki "...m var" yapısına karşılık gelir. Olumsuzu istisnai olarak "不" değil her zaman "没有"'dur: 我没有车 (arabam yok). Soru için ya sona "吗" ya da "有没有" kalıbı kullanılır: 你有没有时间? (vaktin var mı?).

examples.zh: 我们有足够的时间准备考试。

examples.zh: 她有一颗善良的心。

examples.zh: 我们有信心把这件事做好。

examples.en: As long as there's hope, we won't give up.

title: "叫" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "叫" (jiào) tam adı söylemek veya birini çağırmak için kullanılır: 我叫李明 = Adım Li Ming.
explanation: "叫" iki temel işlev görür: (1) İsim/tam ad bildirme: "我叫王小明" (adım Wang Xiaoming). Soyad + ad ya da sadece ad söylenebilir. Ad sormak için "你叫什么名字?". (2) Birini çağırmak/seslenmek: "妈妈叫你回家" (annen seni eve çağırıyor). Sadece soyad söylerken "叫" değil "姓" kullanılır (ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 你好,我叫张伟,很高兴认识你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Zhāng Wěi, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
examples.en: Hello, my name is Zhang Wei, nice to meet you.

examples.zh: 请问你叫什么名字？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.en: May I ask what your name is?

examples.zh: 我家的小狗叫豆豆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de xiǎogǒu jiào Dòudou.
examples.en: My family's puppy is called Doudou.

examples.zh: 妈妈叫你回家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiào nǐ huíjiā chīfàn.
examples.en: Mom is calling you home for dinner.

examples.zh: 这种花叫什么名字？真好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā jiào shénme míngzi? Zhēn hǎokàn.
examples.en: What is this kind of flower called? It's so pretty.

examples.zh: 老师叫我明天去办公室找他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒ míngtiān qù bàngōngshì zhǎo tā.
examples.en: The teacher told me to see him in the office tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我的中文名字叫李月。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén míngzi jiào Lǐ Yuè.
examples.en: My Chinese name is Li Yue.

examples.zh: 外面有人叫你,你去看看吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǒu rén jiào nǐ, nǐ qù kànkan ba.
examples.en: Someone is calling you outside, go take a look.

examples.zh: 他叫我别担心,一切都会好的。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ bié dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de.
examples.en: He told me not to worry, everything will be fine.

examples.zh: 这道菜叫什么？我以前没吃过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài jiào shénme? Wǒ yǐqián méi chīguò.
examples.en: What is this dish called? I've never had it before.

examples.zh: 我们叫了一辆出租车去机场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào le yí liàng chūzūchē qù jīchǎng.
examples.en: We called a taxi to go to the airport.

examples.zh: 他给儿子取的名字叫平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi érzi qǔ de míngzi jiào Píng'ān.
examples.en: The name he gave his son is Ping'an.

examples.zh: 你叫他一声,他可能没听见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiào tā yì shēng, tā kěnéng méi tīngjiàn.
examples.en: Call out to him, he might not have heard.

examples.zh: 这个地方叫什么？我第一次来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jiào shénme? Wǒ dì yī cì lái.
examples.en: What is this place called? It's my first time here.

examples.zh: 经理叫大家下午三点开会。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ jiào dàjiā xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: The manager told everyone to have a meeting at three.

examples.zh: 她叫我帮她照顾一下孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ bāng tā zhàogù yíxià háizi.
examples.en: She asked me to help look after her child.

examples.zh: 这只猫没有名字,你给它起一个吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo méiyǒu míngzi, nǐ gěi tā qǐ yí ge ba.
examples.en: This cat has no name, why don't you give it one.

examples.zh: 别叫我老师,叫我的名字就好。
examples.pinyin: Bié jiào wǒ lǎoshī, jiào wǒ de míngzi jiù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't call me teacher, just call me by my name.

examples.zh: 我叫了很多次,他才慢慢醒过来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiào le hěn duō cì, tā cái mànman xǐng guòlái.
examples.en: I called many times before he slowly woke up.

examples.zh: 这种感觉说不清楚,我不知道该叫什么。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué shuō bu qīngchu, wǒ bù zhīdào gāi jiào shénme.
examples.en: This feeling is hard to describe, I don't know what to call it.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次叫爸爸的时候,他哭了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi dì yī cì jiào bàba de shíhou, tā kū le.
examples.en: When the child called him 'dad' for the first time, he cried.

examples.zh: 我们叫她小美,因为她长得很美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào tā Xiǎoměi, yīnwèi tā zhǎng de hěn měi.
examples.en: We call her Xiaomei because she's very pretty.

examples.zh: 要是有事就叫我,我一直在旁边。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi yǒu shì jiù jiào wǒ, wǒ yìzhí zài pángbiān.
examples.en: Call me if you need anything, I'll be right beside you.

examples.zh: 你知道这条河叫什么名字吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhè tiáo hé jiào shénme míngzi ma?
examples.en: Do you know the name of this river?

examples.zh: 他叫服务员再拿一双筷子。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào fúwùyuán zài ná yì shuāng kuàizi.
examples.en: He asked the waiter to bring another pair of chopsticks.

title: "去" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "去" (qù) bir yere gitmeyi anlatır: 我去学校 = Okula gidiyorum. Konuşandan uzağa doğru hareketi belirtir.
explanation: "去", konuşan kişiden uzaklaşan bir hareketi anlatır ("来" lái tam tersi, konuşana doğru gelmeyi). Kalıp: Özne + 去 + yer. Ayrıca "去" + fiil kalıbıyla "bir şey yapmaya gitmek" anlamı verir: 我去买东西 (alışverişe gidiyorum). Yerden sonra amaç fiili gelebilir. Olumsuzu "不去" (gitmiyorum) veya geçmiş için "没去" (gitmedim).

examples.zh: 我下午要去图书馆借几本书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù túshūguǎn jiè jǐ běn shū.
examples.en: I'm going to the library this afternoon to borrow some books.

examples.zh: 这个周末你去哪儿玩？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ qù nǎr wán?
examples.en: Where are you going to have fun this weekend?

examples.zh: 他去北京出差了,下周才回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Běijīng chūchāi le, xià zhōu cái huílái.
examples.en: He went to Beijing on business, he won't be back until next week.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们去公园走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán zǒuzou ba.
examples.en: The weather is so nice, let's go for a walk in the park.

examples.zh: 我妈妈每天早上去市场买菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma měitiān zǎoshang qù shìchǎng mǎi cài.
examples.en: My mom goes to the market to buy vegetables every morning.

examples.zh: 你想去哪个国家旅行？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎge guójiā lǚxíng?
examples.en: Which country do you want to travel to?

examples.zh: 他病了,今天没去上班。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le, jīntiān méi qù shàngbān.
examples.en: He's sick, so he didn't go to work today.

examples.zh: 我们打算去南方过冬。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn qù nánfāng guòdōng.
examples.en: We plan to go south to spend the winter.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了,要去外地上大学。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà le, yào qù wàidì shàng dàxué.
examples.en: The child has grown up and is going to another city for university.

examples.zh: 我这就去,你在这里等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jiù qù, nǐ zài zhèlǐ děng wǒ.
examples.en: I'll go right now, wait for me here.

examples.zh: 下班以后我要去接孩子。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu wǒ yào qù jiē háizi.
examples.en: After work I have to go pick up my child.

examples.zh: 你去过长城吗？听说很壮观。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qùguò Chángchéng ma? Tīngshuō hěn zhuàngguān.
examples.en: Have you been to the Great Wall? I heard it's magnificent.

examples.zh: 我不想一个人去,你陪我去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng yí ge rén qù, nǐ péi wǒ qù ba.
examples.en: I don't want to go alone, come with me.

examples.zh: 他每年都会去看望乡下的爷爷奶奶。
examples.pinyin: Tā měinián dōu huì qù kànwàng xiāngxià de yéye nǎinai.
examples.en: He visits his grandparents in the countryside every year.

examples.zh: 我们先去吃饭,然后去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù chīfàn, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: Let's first go eat, then go watch a movie.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了,今天就别去了吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, jīntiān jiù bié qù le ba.
examples.en: It's raining outside, let's not go today.

examples.zh: 她去医院看了看生病的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù yīyuàn kàn le kàn shēngbìng de péngyou.
examples.en: She went to the hospital to see her sick friend.

examples.zh: 如果你有空,我们一起去爬山吧。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu kòng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù páshān ba.
examples.en: If you're free, let's go hiking together.

examples.zh: 我去了很多地方,还是觉得家里最好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù le hěn duō dìfang, háishì juéde jiā lǐ zuì hǎo.
examples.en: I've been to many places, but still think home is best.

examples.zh: 他决定去大城市寻找机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng qù dà chéngshì xúnzhǎo jīhuì.
examples.en: He decided to go to the big city to look for opportunities.

examples.zh: 你去哪儿我都跟着你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ dōu gēnzhe nǐ.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow you.

examples.zh: 明天我要去参加一个很重要的面试。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù cānjiā yí ge hěn zhòngyào de miànshì.
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going to an important interview.

examples.zh: 我们不能总是待在家里,该出去走走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zǒngshì dāi zài jiā lǐ, gāi chūqù zǒuzou le.
examples.en: We can't always stay home, it's time to go out.

examples.zh: 他每天下班后都去健身房锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
examples.en: He goes to the gym to work out after work every day.

examples.zh: 这条路我从来没去过,我们看看地图吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ cónglái méi qùguò, wǒmen kànkan dìtú ba.
examples.en: I've never taken this road, let's check the map.

title: "姓" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "姓" (xìng) soyadı bildirmek için kullanılır: 我姓王 = Soyadım Wang. Sadece soyadı ile birlikte kullanılır.
explanation: "姓" özellikle SOYADI söylemek için kullanılan bir fiildir ve sadece soyad alır — tam ad için "叫" kullanılır. "我姓李" (soyadım Li) doğru, ama "我姓李明" yanlıştır (bu durumda "我叫李明" denir). Soyad sormak için: "您贵姓?" (kibar) veya "你姓什么?". Cevap genellikle "我姓 + soyad" şeklindedir.

examples.zh: 您好,请问您贵姓？
examples.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn nín guìxìng?
examples.en: Hello, may I ask your surname?

examples.zh: 我姓王,叫王小明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Wáng Xiǎomíng.
examples.en: My surname is Wang, my name is Wang Xiaoming.

examples.zh: 我们的新老师姓李。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīn lǎoshī xìng Lǐ.
examples.en: Our new teacher's surname is Li.

examples.zh: 他姓张,是我以前的同事。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìng Zhāng, shì wǒ yǐqián de tóngshì.
examples.en: His surname is Zhang, he's my former colleague.

examples.zh: 你姓什么？我好像忘了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xìng shénme? Wǒ hǎoxiàng wàng le.
examples.en: What's your surname? I seem to have forgotten.

examples.zh: 在中国,姓王的人非常多。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, xìng Wáng de rén fēicháng duō.
examples.en: In China, there are very many people surnamed Wang.

examples.zh: 这位客人姓陈,是从上海来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kèrén xìng Chén, shì cóng Shànghǎi lái de.
examples.en: This guest's surname is Chen, he's from Shanghai.

examples.zh: 我爸爸姓刘,我妈妈姓林。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xìng Liú, wǒ māma xìng Lín.
examples.en: My dad's surname is Liu, my mom's is Lin.

examples.zh: 请问那位医生姓什么？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nà wèi yīshēng xìng shénme?
examples.en: May I ask what that doctor's surname is?

examples.zh: 她结婚以后还是用自己原来的姓。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiéhūn yǐhòu háishì yòng zìjǐ yuánlái de xìng.
examples.en: After getting married, she still uses her original surname.

examples.zh: 我们经理姓赵,人很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīnglǐ xìng Zhào, rén hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Our manager's surname is Zhao, he's a nice person.

examples.zh: 孩子一般跟着爸爸姓。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yìbān gēnzhe bàba xìng.
examples.en: Children usually take their father's surname.

examples.zh: 你姓的这个字怎么写？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xìng de zhège zì zěnme xiě?
examples.en: How do you write the character of your surname?

examples.zh: 我认识一个姓周的老先生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi yí ge xìng Zhōu de lǎo xiānsheng.
examples.en: I know an old gentleman surnamed Zhou.

examples.zh: 他不姓王,你可能认错人了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú xìng Wáng, nǐ kěnéng rèncuò rén le.
examples.en: His surname isn't Wang, you might have the wrong person.

examples.zh: 这个村子里的人大部分都姓李。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi lǐ de rén dàbùfen dōu xìng Lǐ.
examples.en: Most people in this village are surnamed Li.

examples.zh: 请问这封信是给一位姓黄的先生的吗？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè fēng xìn shì gěi yí wèi xìng Huáng de xiānsheng de ma?
examples.en: Excuse me, is this letter for a gentleman surnamed Huang?

examples.zh: 我姓的这个姓不太常见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng de zhège xìng bú tài chángjiàn.
examples.en: The surname I have is not very common.

examples.zh: 她姓什么我不清楚,只知道叫小雨。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìng shénme wǒ bù qīngchu, zhǐ zhīdào jiào Xiǎoyǔ.
examples.en: I'm not sure of her surname, I only know she's called Xiaoyu.

examples.zh: 老板姓什么并不重要,重要的是他公不公平。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xìng shénme bìng bú zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì tā gōng bu gōngpíng.
examples.en: What the boss's surname is doesn't matter; what matters is whether he's fair.

examples.zh: 很多外国人不知道中国人姓在前,名在后。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō wàiguórén bù zhīdào Zhōngguórén xìng zài qián, míng zài hòu.
examples.en: Many foreigners don't know that Chinese put the surname first and given name last.

examples.zh: 他自我介绍说他姓孙。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìwǒ jièshào shuō tā xìng Sūn.
examples.en: He introduced himself and said his surname is Sun.

examples.zh: 你父亲姓什么,你就跟着姓什么。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fùqīn xìng shénme, nǐ jiù gēnzhe xìng shénme.
examples.en: Whatever your father's surname is, you take the same.

examples.zh: 这位姓吴的作家写了很多有名的书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xìng Wú de zuòjiā xiě le hěn duō yǒumíng de shū.
examples.en: This writer surnamed Wu has written many famous books.

examples.zh: 我不记得他姓什么了,只记得他很高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú jìde tā xìng shénme le, zhǐ jìde tā hěn gāo.
examples.en: I don't remember his surname, only that he was very tall.

title: "能" ile yetenek veya olasılık
summary: "能" (néng) fiziksel yetenek, koşullara bağlı imkân veya izin anlamında "...ebilmek" verir: 我能游泳 = Yüzebilirim.
explanation: "能" "-ebilmek" anlamında yardımcı fiildir ve üç durumu kapsar: (1) fiziksel/durumsal yetenek (你能搬这个箱子吗? - bu kutuyu taşıyabilir misin?), (2) koşullara bağlı imkân (今天太忙,我不能来 - bugün çok meşgulüm, gelemem), (3) izin (这里能抽烟吗? - burada sigara içilebilir mi?). Sonradan öğrenilen beceri için "会" (huì), izin için "可以" (kěyǐ) tercih edilir; bunlar zaman zaman örtüşür.

examples.zh: 中文这么难,你能学好吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén zhème nán, nǐ néng xuéhǎo ma?
examples.en: Chinese is so hard, can you master it?

examples.zh: 对不起,我今天太忙了,不能陪你。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ jīntiān tài máng le, bù néng péi nǐ.
examples.en: Sorry, I'm too busy today, I can't keep you company.

examples.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhège xiāngzi bān shàng lóu ma?
examples.en: Can you help me carry this box upstairs?

examples.zh: 生病的时候不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou bù néng hējiǔ.
examples.en: You can't drink alcohol when you're sick.

examples.zh: 只要努力,你一定能成功。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, nǐ yídìng néng chénggōng.
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you'll surely succeed.

examples.zh: 这么重要的会议你怎么能迟到？
examples.pinyin: Zhème zhòngyào de huìyì nǐ zěnme néng chídào?
examples.en: How could you be late for such an important meeting?

examples.zh: 我明天能不能请一天假？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān néng bu néng qǐng yì tiān jià?
examples.en: Can I take a day off tomorrow?

examples.zh: 他受伤了,现在还不能走路。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòushāng le, xiànzài hái bù néng zǒulù.
examples.en: He's injured and can't walk yet.

examples.zh: 你能听懂他说的方言吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng tīngdǒng tā shuō de fāngyán ma?
examples.en: Can you understand the dialect he speaks?

examples.zh: 只有互相理解,我们才能一起走下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu hùxiāng lǐjiě, wǒmen cái néng yìqǐ zǒu xiàqù.
examples.en: Only by understanding each other can we keep going together.

examples.zh: 这个时间我恐怕不能到,路上太堵了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíjiān wǒ kǒngpà bù néng dào, lùshang tài dǔ le.
examples.en: I'm afraid I can't make it by then, the traffic is too heavy.

examples.zh: 你能不能小声一点？孩子在睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn? Háizi zài shuìjiào.
examples.en: Can you be a bit quieter? The child is sleeping.

examples.zh: 人不能只想着自己。
examples.pinyin: Rén bù néng zhǐ xiǎngzhe zìjǐ.
examples.en: A person can't just think about themselves.

examples.zh: 我们能做的都做了,剩下的只能等。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zuò de dōu zuò le, shèngxià de zhǐ néng děng.
examples.en: We've done all we can, all that's left is to wait.

examples.zh: 这个秘密你能替我保守吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège mìmì nǐ néng tì wǒ bǎoshǒu ma?
examples.en: Can you keep this secret for me?

examples.zh: 再给我一点时间,我一定能做得更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒ yìdiǎn shíjiān, wǒ yídìng néng zuò de gèng hǎo.
examples.en: Give me a little more time, I can surely do better.

examples.zh: 这么晚了,你一个人能回家吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ yí ge rén néng huíjiā ma?
examples.en: It's so late, can you get home by yourself?

examples.zh: 我们不能让这样的事情再次发生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng ràng zhèyàng de shìqing zàicì fāshēng.
examples.en: We can't let something like this happen again.

examples.zh: 你能想到这一点,说明你很细心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng xiǎngdào zhè yìdiǎn, shuōmíng nǐ hěn xìxīn.
examples.en: That you could think of this shows you're very attentive.

examples.zh: 钱能解决的问题都不算大问题。
examples.pinyin: Qián néng jiějué de wèntí dōu bú suàn dà wèntí.
examples.en: Problems that money can solve aren't really big problems.

examples.zh: 没有你的帮助,我不可能完成这件事。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ bù kěnéng wánchéng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Without your help, I couldn't have finished this.

examples.zh: 他病得很重,能不能好起来还不知道。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng de hěn zhòng, néng bu néng hǎo qǐlái hái bù zhīdào.
examples.en: He's very ill, whether he can recover is still unknown.

examples.zh: 你放心,我能照顾好自己。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ néng zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.
examples.en: Don't worry, I can take care of myself.

examples.zh: 这么小的字,我不戴眼镜看不清。
examples.pinyin: Zhème xiǎo de zì, wǒ bú dài yǎnjìng kàn bu qīng.
examples.en: Such small characters, I can't see clearly without glasses.

examples.zh: 我们能走到今天,真的很不容易。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zǒudào jīntiān, zhēn de hěn bù róngyì.
examples.en: That we could make it this far really wasn't easy.

title: "会" ile öğrenilmiş beceri
summary: "会" (huì) öğrenme sonucu kazanılan bir beceriyi anlatır: 我会说中文 = Çince konuşabilirim (öğrendim).
explanation: "会" özellikle SONRADAN ÖĞRENİLEN beceriler için kullanılır: dil konuşmak, yüzmek, araba kullanmak, yemek yapmak. "能"'den farkı budur — "能" genel yetenek/imkân, "会" ise öğrenilmiş ustalıktır. Olumsuzu "不会". Ayrıca "会" gelecekte bir şeyin olma olasılığını da anlatır: 明天会下雨 (yarın yağmur yağacak) — bu ayrı bir kullanımdır.

examples.zh: 我会说三种语言。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán.
examples.en: I can speak three languages.

examples.zh: 他不会游泳,你别让他下水。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì yóuyǒng, nǐ bié ràng tā xiàshuǐ.
examples.en: He can't swim, don't let him go into the water.

examples.zh: 你会不会开车？我们需要一个司机。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì kāichē? Wǒmen xūyào yí ge sījī.
examples.en: Can you drive? We need a driver.

examples.zh: 我妈妈会做很多好吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma huì zuò hěn duō hǎochī de cài.
examples.en: My mom can make many delicious dishes.

examples.zh: 这个孩子五岁就会弹钢琴了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi wǔ suì jiù huì tán gāngqín le.
examples.en: This child could play the piano at five.

examples.zh: 以前我不会用筷子,现在很熟练了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ bú huì yòng kuàizi, xiànzài hěn shúliàn le.
examples.en: I couldn't use chopsticks before, now I'm quite skilled.

examples.zh: 她会画画,也会写诗。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì huàhuà, yě huì xiě shī.
examples.en: She can paint and also write poetry.

examples.zh: 我还不太会做这道菜,你能教我吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái bú tài huì zuò zhè dào cài, nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.en: I don't really know how to make this dish, can you teach me?

examples.zh: 学了一年以后,他终于会用中文写信了。
examples.pinyin: Xué le yì nián yǐhòu, tā zhōngyú huì yòng Zhōngwén xiěxìn le.
examples.en: After a year of study, he can finally write letters in Chinese.

examples.zh: 你会不会觉得我问得太多了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì juéde wǒ wèn de tài duō le?
examples.en: Do you feel that I'm asking too much?

examples.zh: 只要用心,谁都会做好这件事。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào yòngxīn, shéi dōu huì zuòhǎo zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: As long as one puts their heart into it, anyone can do this well.

examples.zh: 他会好几种乐器,真让人羡慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì hǎojǐ zhǒng yuèqì, zhēn ràng rén xiànmù.
examples.en: He can play several instruments, really enviable.

examples.zh: 这么简单的字你怎么会不会写？
examples.pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de zì nǐ zěnme huì bú huì xiě?
examples.en: How can you not know how to write such a simple character?

examples.zh: 我相信努力练习,你一定会成功。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǔlì liànxí, nǐ yídìng huì chénggōng.
examples.en: I believe that with hard practice, you'll surely succeed.

examples.zh: 她会跳很多种舞,芭蕾跳得最好。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tiào hěn duō zhǒng wǔ, bālěi tiào de zuì hǎo.
examples.en: She can dance many styles, and does ballet best.

examples.zh: 孩子小时候学的东西,长大了也不会忘。
examples.pinyin: Háizi xiǎoshíhou xué de dōngxi, zhǎngdà le yě bú huì wàng.
examples.en: What children learn when young, they won't forget when grown.

examples.zh: 你会用这个新软件吗？我完全不懂。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng zhège xīn ruǎnjiàn ma? Wǒ wánquán bù dǒng.
examples.en: Do you know how to use this new software? I have no idea.

examples.zh: 他不会拒绝别人,总是答应帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì jùjué biérén, zǒngshì dāying bāngmáng.
examples.en: He can't say no to people, always agrees to help.

examples.zh: 会说和会写是两回事。
examples.pinyin: Huì shuō hé huì xiě shì liǎng huí shì.
examples.en: Being able to speak and being able to write are two different things.

examples.zh: 我小时候会骑马,现在都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou huì qímǎ, xiànzài dōu wàng le.
examples.en: I could ride a horse as a child, now I've forgotten how.

examples.zh: 这种技术不是每个人都会的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jìshù bú shì měi ge rén dōu huì de.
examples.en: This skill is not something everyone has.

examples.zh: 她会好几门外语,工作起来很方便。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì hǎojǐ mén wàiyǔ, gōngzuò qǐlái hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: She knows several foreign languages, which makes work convenient.

examples.zh: 只有真正热爱,你才会一直坚持下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng rè'ài, nǐ cái huì yìzhí jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.en: Only if you truly love it will you keep at it.

examples.zh: 我不会忘记你对我的好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì wàngjì nǐ duì wǒ de hǎo.
examples.en: I won't forget how good you've been to me.

examples.zh: 他做饭很好吃,可是不会收拾厨房。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòfàn hěn hǎochī, kěshì bú huì shōushi chúfáng.
examples.en: He cooks delicious food, but doesn't know how to clean up the kitchen.

title: "要" ile "...ecek/...acak" (gelecek/niyet)
summary: "要" (yào) yakın gelecekte yapılacak/olacak bir eylemi anlatır: 我要去北京 = Pekin'e gideceğim.
explanation: "要", planlanmış veya yakında olacak bir eylemi ifade eder ("...ecek"). Genellikle cümle sonuna "了" eklenerek eylemin çok yakın olduğu vurgulanır: 火车要开了 (tren kalkmak üzere). Olumsuz gelecek için "要" değil "不" kullanılır: 我明天不去 (yarın gitmeyeceğim). "要" ayrıca "istemek" (bir sonraki konu) ve "gerekmek" anlamlarına da gelir; bağlam ayırt eder.

examples.zh: 快点儿,火车要开了！
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎnr, huǒchē yào kāi le!
examples.en: Hurry up, the train is about to leave!

examples.zh: 我下个月要去日本旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào qù Rìběn lǚxíng.
examples.en: I'm going to travel to Japan next month.

examples.zh: 天要黑了,我们该回家了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān yào hēi le, wǒmen gāi huíjiā le.
examples.en: It's getting dark, we should head home.

examples.zh: 他明年要结婚了,大家都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngnián yào jiéhūn le, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: He's getting married next year, everyone is happy.

examples.zh: 看样子要下雨了,你带伞了吗？
examples.pinyin: Kàn yàngzi yào xiàyǔ le, nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
examples.en: It looks like it's going to rain, did you bring an umbrella?

examples.zh: 我们要搬家了,以后见面的机会不多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bānjiā le, yǐhòu jiànmiàn de jīhuì bù duō le.
examples.en: We're moving, so we won't get to meet often anymore.

examples.zh: 孩子明年就要上小学了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi míngnián jiù yào shàng xiǎoxué le.
examples.en: The child is going to start primary school next year.

examples.zh: 我要努力工作,给家人更好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào nǔlì gōngzuò, gěi jiārén gèng hǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I'm going to work hard to give my family a better life.

examples.zh: 电影要开始了,快把手机关了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng yào kāishǐ le, kuài bǎ shǒujī guān le.
examples.en: The movie is about to start, turn off your phone.

examples.zh: 他说他要来,可是到现在还没到。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā yào lái, kěshì dào xiànzài hái méi dào.
examples.en: He said he'd come, but he still hasn't arrived.

examples.zh: 春天要到了,树上开始长新叶子了。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān yào dào le, shù shàng kāishǐ zhǎng xīn yèzi le.
examples.en: Spring is coming, new leaves are growing on the trees.

examples.zh: 我要在这个城市重新开始我的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài zhège chéngshì chóngxīn kāishǐ wǒ de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I'm going to start my life anew in this city.

examples.zh: 考试要到了,我得抓紧时间复习。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì yào dào le, wǒ děi zhuājǐn shíjiān fùxí.
examples.en: The exam is coming, I have to hurry and review.

examples.zh: 你要走了吗？再坐一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zǒu le ma? Zài zuò yíhuìr ba.
examples.en: Are you leaving? Sit a while longer.

examples.zh: 这本书我快要看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kuài yào kànwán le.
examples.en: I'm almost finished reading this book.

examples.zh: 公司要开一个重要的会议,大家都得参加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yào kāi yí ge zhòngyào de huìyì, dàjiā dōu děi cānjiā.
examples.en: The company is going to hold an important meeting, everyone must attend.

examples.zh: 我们的假期要结束了,真舍不得。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàqī yào jiéshù le, zhēn shěbùdé.
examples.en: Our vacation is ending, I really don't want it to.

examples.zh: 他要退休了,同事们给他准备了礼物。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào tuìxiū le, tóngshìmen gěi tā zhǔnbèi le lǐwù.
examples.en: He's retiring, and his colleagues prepared a gift for him.

examples.zh: 我明天一早要出发,今晚得早点睡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yìzǎo yào chūfā, jīnwǎn děi zǎodiǎn shuì.
examples.en: I'm leaving early tomorrow, so I need to sleep early tonight.

examples.zh: 看他的样子,好像要哭了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn tā de yàngzi, hǎoxiàng yào kū le.
examples.en: By the look of him, it seems he's about to cry.

examples.zh: 我们的孩子要长大了,时间过得真快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de háizi yào zhǎngdà le, shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài.
examples.en: Our child is growing up, time really flies.

examples.zh: 你要去哪儿？我送你一程吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào qù nǎr? Wǒ sòng nǐ yì chéng ba.
examples.en: Where are you going? Let me give you a ride part of the way.

examples.zh: 新的一年要开始了,祝你一切顺利。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de yì nián yào kāishǐ le, zhù nǐ yíqiè shùnlì.
examples.en: A new year is beginning, I wish you all the best.

examples.zh: 雨要停了,天空慢慢亮了起来。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yào tíng le, tiānkōng mànman liàng le qǐlái.
examples.en: The rain is about to stop, the sky is slowly brightening.

examples.zh: 我快要坚持不住了,可是我不想放弃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kuài yào jiānchí bú zhù le, kěshì wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.en: I'm about to reach my limit, but I don't want to give up.

title: "可以" ile izin
summary: "可以" (kěyǐ) izin verme veya izin isteme anlamında "...ebilir / ...abilir miyim" verir: 我可以进来吗？ = İçeri girebilir miyim?
explanation: "可以" ağırlıklı olarak İZİN bildirir: "这里可以拍照" (burada fotoğraf çekilebilir). İzin istemek için soru yapılır: "我可以坐这里吗?" (buraya oturabilir miyim?). Kısaca izin vermek için sadece "可以" denir. Olumsuz/yasak için genellikle "不可以" ya da "不能" kullanılır. "可以" ayrıca imkân ve "fena değil/iyi" anlamlarına da gelebilir.

examples.zh: 请问,我可以坐这里吗？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèlǐ ma?
examples.en: Excuse me, may I sit here?

examples.zh: 这个博物馆里不可以拍照。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn lǐ bù kěyǐ pāizhào.
examples.en: You can't take photos in this museum.

examples.zh: 你可以用我的电脑,密码是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de diànnǎo, mìmǎ shì wǒ de shēngri.
examples.en: You can use my computer, the password is my birthday.

examples.zh: 孩子做完作业以后可以看一会儿电视。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zuòwán zuòyè yǐhòu kěyǐ kàn yíhuìr diànshì.
examples.en: The child can watch TV for a while after finishing homework.

examples.zh: 这里可以抽烟吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ chōuyān ma?
examples.en: Can I smoke here?

examples.zh: 你可以慢慢想,不用着急回答。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ mànman xiǎng, búyòng zháojí huídá.
examples.en: You can take your time, no need to answer in a hurry.

examples.zh: 这张票一个人可以带一个孩子进去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào yí ge rén kěyǐ dài yí ge háizi jìnqù.
examples.en: With this ticket one person can bring one child in.

examples.zh: 如果你不舒服,可以先回去休息。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù shūfu, kěyǐ xiān huíqù xiūxi.
examples.en: If you're not feeling well, you can go back and rest.

examples.zh: 这件事你可以问问经理的意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ kěyǐ wènwen jīnglǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.en: You can ask the manager's opinion about this.

examples.zh: 对不起,这个座位已经有人了,你不可以坐。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, zhège zuòwèi yǐjīng yǒu rén le, nǐ bù kěyǐ zuò.
examples.en: Sorry, this seat is taken, you can't sit here.

examples.zh: 你可以相信我,我不会告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiāngxìn wǒ, wǒ bú huì gàosù biérén.
examples.en: You can trust me, I won't tell anyone.

examples.zh: 我们可以换个地方谈吗？这里太吵了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ huàn ge dìfang tán ma? Zhèlǐ tài chǎo le.
examples.en: Can we talk somewhere else? It's too noisy here.

examples.zh: 这种药一天可以吃两次。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào yì tiān kěyǐ chī liǎng cì.
examples.en: This medicine can be taken twice a day.

examples.zh: 你可以试一试,不试怎么知道行不行？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shì yi shì, bú shì zěnme zhīdào xíng bu xíng?
examples.en: You can give it a try; how will you know if it works without trying?

examples.zh: 这里的书可以借回家看。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shū kěyǐ jiè huíjiā kàn.
examples.en: The books here can be borrowed and taken home to read.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,不可以一个人过马路。
examples.pinyin: Háizi hái xiǎo, bù kěyǐ yí ge rén guò mǎlù.
examples.en: The child is still young and can't cross the road alone.

examples.zh: 你可以告诉我发生了什么事吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gàosù wǒ fāshēng le shénme shì ma?
examples.en: Can you tell me what happened?

examples.zh: 这个价钱还可以,我们买下来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàqián hái kěyǐ, wǒmen mǎi xiàlái ba.
examples.en: This price is okay, let's buy it.

examples.zh: 你随时可以给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ suíshí kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: You can call me anytime.

examples.zh: 这些资料你可以拿去用,不用还给我。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào nǐ kěyǐ ná qù yòng, búyòng huán gěi wǒ.
examples.en: You can take these materials to use, no need to return them.

examples.zh: 人可以失败,但是不可以放弃。
examples.pinyin: Rén kěyǐ shībài, dànshì bù kěyǐ fàngqì.
examples.en: A person can fail, but must not give up.

examples.zh: 你今天可以早点走,剩下的我来做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān kěyǐ zǎodiǎn zǒu, shèngxià de wǒ lái zuò.
examples.en: You can leave early today, I'll do the rest.

examples.zh: 这条河夏天可以游泳,冬天可以滑冰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé xiàtiān kěyǐ yóuyǒng, dōngtiān kěyǐ huábīng.
examples.en: You can swim in this river in summer and skate on it in winter.

examples.zh: 有问题的话,你可以随时来找我。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí dehuà, nǐ kěyǐ suíshí lái zhǎo wǒ.
examples.en: If you have questions, you can come to me anytime.

examples.zh: 这件事我一个人可以处理,你放心吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yí ge rén kěyǐ chǔlǐ, nǐ fàngxīn ba.
examples.en: I can handle this on my own, don't worry.

title: "要" ile bir şey isteme
summary: "要" (yào) bir şeyi istemek/talep etmek anlamında da kullanılır: 我要一杯水 = Bir bardak su istiyorum.
explanation: "要", gelecek anlamının yanı sıra güçlü bir istek/talep de bildirir. İsimle: "我要一杯咖啡" (bir kahve istiyorum) — sipariş verirken çok yaygındır. Fiille: "我要学中文" (Çince öğrenmek istiyorum). "想" (xiǎng) daha yumuşak bir istek/arzu bildirir; "要" daha kararlı/kesindir. "要"'nun olumsuzu istek anlamında "不想" veya "不要" olabilir (bağlama göre).

examples.zh: 服务员,我要一份牛肉面。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒ yào yí fèn niúròu miàn.
examples.en: Waiter, I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.zh: 我要好好学习,将来做一个有用的人。

title: "怎么" ile "nasıl" sorusu
summary: "怎么" (zěnme) bir eylemin nasıl yapıldığını sorar: 怎么走？ = Nasıl gidilir?
explanation: "怎么" fiilin önüne gelerek eylemin YÖNTEMİNİ/BİÇİMİNİ sorar: 这个字怎么写? (bu karakter nasıl yazılır?), 怎么去机场? (havaalanına nasıl gidilir?). Ayrıca "怎么" bir durumun sebebini/şaşkınlığını da ifade edebilir: 你怎么还没睡? (nasıl olur da hâlâ uyumadın?). Bu soru kelimesi de olduğu yerde kalır, cümle başına taşınmaz.

examples.zh: 请问,去火车站怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu?
examples.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

examples.zh: 这个字怎么写？我总是记不住。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì zěnme xiě? Wǒ zǒngshì jì bu zhù.
examples.en: How do you write this character? I can never remember.

examples.zh: 这道菜怎么做？闻起来真香。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zěnme zuò? Wén qǐlái zhēn xiāng.
examples.en: How is this dish made? It smells so good.

examples.zh: 你怎么知道我今天不开心？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ jīntiān bù kāixīn?
examples.en: How did you know I'm unhappy today?

examples.zh: 这个机器怎么用,你能教教我吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège jīqì zěnme yòng, nǐ néng jiāojiao wǒ ma?
examples.en: How do you use this machine? Can you teach me?

examples.zh: 你怎么才来？我们等你半天了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme cái lái? Wǒmen děng nǐ bàntiān le.
examples.en: How come you're only just arriving? We've waited for ages.

examples.zh: 这个问题应该怎么解决,大家一起想想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yīnggāi zěnme jiějué, dàjiā yìqǐ xiǎngxiang.
examples.en: How should we solve this problem? Let's all think about it.

examples.zh: 你怎么把这么重要的事忘了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bǎ zhème zhòngyào de shì wàng le?

examples.zh: 这个词是什么意思,怎么用？
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí shì shénme yìsi, zěnme yòng?
examples.en: What does this word mean, and how is it used?

examples.zh: 我不知道以后的路该怎么走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào yǐhòu de lù gāi zěnme zǒu.
examples.en: I don't know how to proceed from here.

examples.zh: 你怎么一个人在这里,你朋友呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yí ge rén zài zhèlǐ, nǐ péngyou ne?
examples.en: How come you're here alone? Where are your friends?

examples.zh: 这么复杂的事,你是怎么处理的？
examples.pinyin: Zhème fùzá de shì, nǐ shì zěnme chǔlǐ de?
examples.en: How did you handle something so complicated?

examples.zh: 电脑坏了,你知道怎么修吗？
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo huài le, nǐ zhīdào zěnme xiū ma?
examples.en: The computer is broken, do you know how to fix it?

examples.zh: 你怎么突然改变主意了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme tūrán gǎibiàn zhǔyi le?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gāi zěnme gēn tā shuō ne?

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen shì zěnme rènshi de? Gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang.

examples.zh: 外面这么冷,你怎么不多穿点儿？
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn zhème lěng, nǐ zěnme bù duō chuān diǎnr?

examples.zh: 这么远的路,你打算怎么去？

examples.zh: 日子再难,也得想办法过下去。你说该怎么办？

examples.en: I keep wondering how this actually happened.

examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zěnme shuō, nǐ dōu yīnggāi xiān dào ge qiàn.
examples.en: No matter what, you should apologize first.

title: "没有" ile geçmiş eylemin olumsuzu
summary: Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir eylem "不" ile değil, "没(有)" ile olumsuzlanır: 我没去 = Gitmedim.
explanation: Bir eylemin GERÇEKLEŞMEDİĞİNİ (geçmiş) söylerken "不" değil "没(有)" kullanılır. "我不去" = gitmiyorum/gitmeyeceğim (irade/gelecek), "我没去" = gitmedim (gerçekleşmedi). "没" ile birlikte "了" KULLANILMAZ çünkü eylem tamamlanmamıştır: "我没吃" doğru, "我没吃了" yanlıştır. Konuşmada "有" düşüp sadece "没" kalabilir.

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly, can you say it again?

examples.pinyin: Tā yì wǎnshang dōu méi shuì, yǎnjing hónghóng de.
examples.en: He didn't sleep all night, his eyes are all red.

examples.en: I waited a long time, but she never came.

examples.en: I haven't told anyone about this yet.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā dǎ le hǎojǐ cì diànhuà, tā dōu méi jiē.

examples.en: I didn't do anything wrong, why should I apologize to him?

title: "不要" ile olumsuz emir
summary: "不要" (búyào) bir eylemi yapmamayı söyler: 不要说话！ = Konuşma!
explanation: "不要", birine bir şeyi YAPMAMASINI söyleyen olumsuz emir kalıbıdır: 不要迟到 (geç kalma). Daha kısa/samimi biçimi "别" (bié) ile aynı anlama gelir: 不要走 = 别走 (gitme). "不要" ayrıca "...istemiyorum" anlamında da kullanılabilir (bağlam ayırt eder). Nazikçe rica için başına "请" eklenir: 请不要吸烟 (lütfen sigara içmeyin).

examples.zh: 上课的时候不要说话。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou búyào shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't talk during class.

examples.zh: 你不要担心,一切都会好起来的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de.
examples.en: Don't worry, everything will be okay.

examples.zh: 开车的时候请不要看手机。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou qǐng búyào kàn shǒujī.
examples.en: Please don't look at your phone while driving.

examples.zh: 这件事不要告诉别人,是个秘密。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì búyào gàosù biérén, shì ge mìmì.
examples.en: Don't tell anyone about this, it's a secret.

examples.zh: 不要浪费时间,快去做作业吧。
examples.pinyin: Búyào làngfèi shíjiān, kuài qù zuò zuòyè ba.
examples.en: Don't waste time, go do your homework.

examples.zh: 你不要生气,听我解释一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào shēngqì, tīng wǒ jiěshì yíxià.
examples.en: Don't be angry, let me explain.

examples.zh: 天太黑了,你不要一个人走。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi le, nǐ búyào yí ge rén zǒu.
examples.en: It's too dark, don't walk alone.

examples.zh: 不要因为一次失败就放弃。
examples.pinyin: Búyào yīnwèi yí cì shībài jiù fàngqì.
examples.en: Don't give up just because of one failure.

examples.zh: 你不要总是拿自己跟别人比。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zǒngshì ná zìjǐ gēn biérén bǐ.
examples.en: Don't always compare yourself to others.

examples.zh: 请大家不要在这里大声说话。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā búyào zài zhèlǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.en: Please don't speak loudly here.

examples.zh: 不要相信那些没有根据的话。
examples.pinyin: Búyào xiāngxìn nàxiē méiyǒu gēnjù de huà.
examples.en: Don't believe those unfounded words.

examples.zh: 你不要把所有的事都放在心上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào bǎ suǒyǒu de shì dōu fàng zài xīn shàng.
examples.en: Don't take everything to heart.

examples.zh: 东西还没坏,不要着急扔掉。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxi hái méi huài, búyào zháojí rēngdiào.
examples.en: The thing isn't broken yet, don't rush to throw it away.

examples.zh: 不要害怕犯错,错误也是一种学习。

examples.zh: 你不要太累了,记得好好休息。

examples.en: Don't overtire yourself, remember to rest well.

examples.zh: 不要对陌生人说太多自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Búyào duì mòshēngrén shuō tài duō zìjǐ de shì.
examples.en: Don't tell strangers too much about yourself.

examples.zh: 请不要随便动我桌子上的东西。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào suíbiàn dòng wǒ zhuōzi shàng de dōngxi.

examples.zh: 你不要小看这件小事,它很重要。

title: Temel cümle dizilişi
summary: Çince'nin temel cümle dizilişi Türkçe'den farklıdır: Özne + Fiil + Nesne (SVO). 我爱你 = Ben seviyorum seni.
explanation: Çince cümle temeli Özne-Fiil-Nesne (SVO) sırasını izler — İngilizce gibi, Türkçe'den (SOV) farklı. "我爱你" (ben-sev-seni), "他喝水" (o-iç-su). Zaman ve yer belirteçleri genellikle öznenin hemen ardında, fiilden ÖNCE gelir: "我明天在家看书" (ben-yarın-evde-oku-kitap). Bu temel iskelet üzerine tüm diğer yapılar kurulur.

title: "是" ile isimleri bağlama (A 是 B)
summary: "是" (shì) İngilizce'deki "to be" gibi iki ismi eşitler: A 是 B = A, B'dir. 我是学生 = Ben öğrenciyim.
explanation: "是", iki ismi/isim öbeğini birbirine bağlayan bağlaç-fiildir (kimlik/tanım): 他是医生 (o doktordur). ÖNEMLİ: "是" sıfatlarla KULLANILMAZ — "我是高" yanlıştır; sıfat için "很" kullanılır (我很高). "是" sadece "isim + isim" bağlar. Olumsuzu "不是". Vurgu/onay için "是" tek başına "evet/öyle" anlamında da kullanılır.

title: "太...了" ile "aşırı/çok"
summary: "太...了" (tài...le) bir sıfatın aşırılığını/yoğunluğunu vurgular: 太好了！ = Çok güzel!
explanation: "太" sıfatın önüne, "了" cümle sonuna gelerek "aşırı derecede / çok" anlamı verir: 太贵了 (çok pahalı), 太累了 (çok yorgun). Genellikle bir şeyin fazla olmasından yakınmayı (太吵了 - çok gürültülü) ya da güçlü olumlu/olumsuz duyguyu (太好了 - harika!) ifade eder. "太"'dan sonra "了"'yu unutmamak önemlidir; "了"'suz "太" biraz eksik durur.

title: Basit "isim + sıfat" cümleleri
summary: Çince'de sıfat yüklem olduğunda "是" kullanılmaz; sıfattan önce genellikle "很" (hěn) gelir: 我很好 = Ben iyiyim.
explanation: Sıfat yüklemli cümlelerde "是" KULLANILMAZ (bu çok yaygın bir hatadır). Bunun yerine sıfat doğrudan yüklem olur ve önüne genellikle "很" konur: 天气很好 (hava güzel). Buradaki "很" her zaman "çok" anlamı taşımaz; çıplak sıfat kıyaslama çağrıştırdığı için dengeleyici bir dolgu görevi görür. Olumsuzda "很" düşer: 天气不好 (hava güzel değil).

examples.en: The weather is nice today, let's go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 这个房间很干净,也很安静。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn gānjìng, yě hěn ānjìng.
examples.en: This room is very clean and also quiet.

examples.zh: 他人很好,大家都喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Tā rén hěn hǎo, dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: He is a nice person, everyone likes him.

examples.zh: 这条路不太好走,你小心一点。

title: Olumlu-olumsuz soru (Fiil 不 Fiil)
pattern: Fiil + 不 + Fiil ? / Sıfat + 不 + Sıfat ?
summary: Fiil veya sıfatın olumlu ve olumsuz biçimini yan yana koyarak soru sorulur: 你去不去？ = Gidiyor musun?
explanation: "吗" kullanmadan soru sormanın bir yolu, yüklemin olumlu + olumsuz biçimini art arda söylemektir: 好不好? (iyi mi?), 是不是? (öyle mi?), 去不去? (gidiyor mu?). Cevap, olumlu ya da olumsuz biçimden biriyle verilir. Bu yapıda cümle sonuna "吗" EKLENMEZ (ikisi birlikte kullanılmaz). Çok heceli fiillerde genellikle ilk hece tekrarlanır: 喜不喜欢?

examples.zh: 你明天来不来我的生日聚会？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān lái bu lái wǒ de shēngri jùhuì?
examples.en: Are you coming to my birthday party tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这道菜辣不辣？我不太能吃辣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài là bu là? Wǒ bú tài néng chī là.
examples.en: Is this dish spicy? I can't handle spicy food well.

examples.zh: 你喜不喜欢这个礼物？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bu xǐhuan zhège lǐwù?
examples.en: Do you like this gift?

examples.zh: 这件衣服你觉得合不合适？

examples.en: Do you think this outfit suits me?

examples.en: Does he really want to help us or not?
